statements: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.DOCUMENT_QUEUE', N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE dbo.DOCUMENT_QUEUE  (D_ID INT PRIMARY KEY, DOCUMENT_ID INT, COPIES INT, REQUESTOR NVARCHAR(255), QUEUE_DATE DATETIME, PRINT_LOCATION INT)

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CORRESPONDENCE_JOURNAL', N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE dbo.CORRESPONDENCE_JOURNAL  (FILE_NUMBER NVARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY, CORRESPONDENCE_ID INT, DOCUMENT_ID INT, INDEX ix_DOCUMENT_ID_FILE_NUMBER (DOCUMENT_ID, FILE_NUMBER))

INSERT INTO DOCUMENT_QUEUE (D_ID, DOCUMENT_ID, COPIES, REQUESTOR, QUEUE_DATE, PRINT_LOCATION) SELECT n, n * 10, n % 5, CONCAT('Requestor_', n), DATEADD(DAY, -n % 30, GETDATE()), n % 3 FROM (SELECT TOP 10000 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS n FROM master.dbo.spt_values) AS numbers

INSERT INTO CORRESPONDENCE_JOURNAL (FILE_NUMBER, CORRESPONDENCE_ID, DOCUMENT_ID) SELECT CONCAT('File_', n), n, n * 10 FROM (SELECT TOP 10000 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS n FROM master.dbo.spt_values) AS numbers
